title: Nylas event.deleted notification object
description: Sent when an event is deleted from a user's calendar. This schema describes `data.object` inside the Nylas notification envelope.

grant_id.description: Unique identifier for the grant that owned this event.

calendar_id.description: Identifier for the calendar this event belonged to. May be `null` in rare edge cases.

id.description: Unique identifier for the deleted event.

master_event_id.description: If this was an occurrence of a recurring event, the ID of the master event. Absent for non-recurring events.

metadata.description: Custom key-value metadata attached to the event. May be omitted if not set.
